The one-site-binding model and the 2:2 stoichiometry are in line with Nup358-min binding as a dimer to a single binding site on a BicD2 coiled-coil dimer, although we cannot exclude the possibility that two Nup358 monomers bind to two binding sites on BicD2, where both sites have the same dissociation constant KD.
